route_title: Visible-Reflecting DBR with Quarter-Wave Stack at 550 nm
compilation_rationale: Bounded 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica. Quarter-wave initialization at 550 nm placed within [65, 105] nm bounds. Learning rate halved to 0.025. Two mean-objective bands target high transmission (1530–1565 nm) and high reflection (400–700 nm) at normal incidence. Coherent smatrix solver applied. Inter-layer variance regularization acknowledged as optimizer guidance.
